cohort: The study included 2158 pregnant women registered between January 1, 2022, and September 30, 2023, at two hospitals in southwest China.
finding: SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy is associated with increased placenta increta/percreta and postpartum hemorrhage, with first trimester infections linked to higher preterm birth and lower intrahepatic cholestasis, and third trimester infections to higher postpartum hemorrhage.
